target_customer: Per the YC listing and company site, ecommerce store operators; per the YC launch post title and several databases, commercial real estate brokerages
problem: Merchants want an AI agent that recommends products and bundles to shoppers. The launch post instead frames the problem as brokers spending time on slow repetitive deal tasks.
product_category: AI agent (ecommerce shopping or commercial real estate workflow, sources conflict)

founders.name: Anmol Tukrel
prior_employers: Google (product manager on Gemini, NotebookLM and Flow monetization; earlier APM on Gmail and Photos)
previous_startups: High school app with users in 120+ countries

founders.name: Chinmay Patel
education: Stanford, BS and MS in computer science
Harvard and MIT joint master's program
founders.background_notes: From the YC company page; worked with John Hennessy on ReadRite per the page.

exit.reason: YC lists the company as Inactive; no shutdown or acquisition report found, and the company site showed a May 2026 publish date.

competitors.name: Henry AI
competitors.what: AI platform automating commercial real estate transactions, the market named in Closera's YC launch post title

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that read product or deal data and act on it are standard LLM engineering; the site's claimed customer graph and safety layer are unverified.

defensibility.rationale: Two person team, no disclosed customers or proprietary data, and many AI shopping and CRE agent startups with funding.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy of Closera was documented.

market_need_then: Agentic commerce and AI brokerage tools drew funding in 2025. The site's conversion lift claims are inconsistent (600 percent, 36 percent, 20 percent AOV) and unverified.

branding.domain_note: closera.com exact match used per YC listing; acquisition history not found.
branding.community_and_virality: A USPTO word mark CLOSERA was filed by Closera, Inc. on 2025-08-26 per trademark listings; no community or press about the brand found.

brand_strength.rationale: Only listings and a trademark record exist; the name sounds like 'closer', which fits sales, but brand conflicts in descriptions across sites show it was not yet distinct.

outcome_analysis: Closera was a two founder Stanford and Google backed team in Summer 2025 that closed a small pre-seed quickly according to a September 2025 interview digest. Its public positioning is inconsistent, ecommerce shopping agent on its site and YC listing but commercial real estate on the launch post, and YC now lists it as Inactive with no stated cause, so the reason it stalled is not public.
notes: The YC launch post fetch returned only the generic YC home page, so the launch post content comes from search snippets (title 'Harvey for Commercial Real Estate'). The product description conflicts between sources (ecommerce on YC page text and closera.com, CRE on launch post and VCBacked); order and any pivot are unknown so pivots is empty. The pre-seed round rests on VCBacked and Employbl (Diffbot data); Neuronfeed gives a different stage and date (Seed, Jan 2025), treated as unreliable. Henry AI is listed because the launch post names the CRE market; if the ecommerce description is the true product it would not apply. Cause of Inactive status not found.
